mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coins (user_id, manuscript_id, coin_count, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{manuscriptId}, #{coinCount}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE coins SET coin_count = #{coinCount} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coins WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND manuscript_id = #{manuscriptId}
